capabilities: scan a Boox device for exported PDF and PNG notes
select new and changed notes in a dialog before syncing
download only new or changed files incrementally
preserve notebook folder structure in the vault
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync tool; it only imports notes exported from a Boox device's Notes app.
extras: Requires the Boox device and the computer running Obsidian to be on the same WiFi network, and notes must be exported from the Boox Notes app as PDF or PNG before syncing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull handwritten notes off an Onyx Boox device into a vault.

relations.evidence: Sync handwritten notes from your Onyx Boox device to Obsidian via BooxDrop.

summary: Syncs handwritten notes exported as PDF or PNG from an Onyx Boox e-ink tablet into the vault via BooxDrop, with selective incremental transfers.
